description.value: Tugboat Annie's Pub & Grille is a family-operated waterfront pub at Shelter Island Marina in East Richmond, sitting steps from the Fraser River with picturesque views from a newly renovated riverside patio. Open since 1986 and run by the McPhail family throughout, it serves classic pub fare alongside a full drinks menu and operates an attached liquor store. Note that this is an adult-only (19+) venue.
